prints.title: Prints
prints.intro: Your print catalog: albums, frames, canvas and more. Clients order a print of any photo from their gallery.
prints.offerOn: Clients see “Order a print” on each photo in their gallery. You can switch it off for a single gallery from its settings.
prints.offerOff: Clients can't order prints. Turn this on when your catalog is ready.
prints.offerNoItems: Add at least one available print option, or clients won't see the button.
prints.optedOut: {count, plural, one {# gallery doesn't offer prints.} other {# galleries don't offer prints.}}
prints.saveFailed: That change wasn't saved. Check your connection and try again.
prints.empty: Add the prints you offer, like an A4 album or a 30x40 frame, with a price for each size.
prints.deleteBody: Clients can no longer order it. Existing orders keep their details.

drawer.name: Print name
drawer.availabilityHint: Unavailable prints are hidden from clients.
drawer.sizeRequired: Enter a size, e.g. A4 or 30x40 cm.
drawer.priceInvalid: Enter a price in EGP, e.g. 650.
drawer.imageFailed: The print was saved, but the picture wasn't. Use a JPEG or PNG up to 15 MB and try again.
